policy.fractions_are: SILVER product occupancy summaries, not ground truth; never cite as accuracy
policy.no_30m_to_10m: GEODATA and CMSA are never rasterized onto 10 m supports; CM-SSM supports 10 m and 30 m; CMSA 30 m per Issue #19 policy
policy.negative_semantics: no source provides verified negatives; GEODATA in-window background is a WEAK negative only; vector backgrounds remain UNKNOWN
policy.positive_only_classification: positive-only polygon products never assign PURE_NEGATIVE: 0 < fraction < 0.9 = MIXED, fraction = 0/NaN = UNKNOWN
policy.source_repair: GeoDataFrame.make_valid() on derived copies only; |area change| < 1% asserted; source archives never modified
